overview: Marilyne Delange, a medium, uses her gift to predict the future by helping her friends and neighbors.
title: Ma voyante préférée

overview: Over-the-top and unfiltered, celebrity chef Matty Matheson whips up global comfort foods on a culinary adventure that's equal parts lessons and laughs.
title: Just a Dash

overview: The series tells the story of the Zaguri family from Beersheba. The series begins with the return home of prodigal son Aviel, who was kicked out of the house by the family patriarch years earlier. His sudden return tears up the house and ignites an internal war, which further intensifies when the family starts believing they are cursed.
title: Zaguri Imperia

overview: Sarah Jessica Parker returns to HBO in the new comedy series, Divorce. Parker stars as Frances, a woman who suddenly begins to reassess her life and her marriage, and finds that making a clean break and a fresh start is harder than she thought.
title: Divorce

overview: While on vacation at his old friend François's cottage, Sergeant Pelletier finds himself embroiled in a murder investigation led by Regional Sergeant Évelyne Dumoulin. This unexpected investigation will change Pelletier forever.
title: Alertes: Pelletier

overview: A masked online fortune teller predicts the murders of social media influencers, sparking an investigation led by a veteran detective and his mentee.
title: Million-Follower Detective

overview: Straight to Hell examines the untold life of one of modern Japan's most influential and controversial figures. Born in the aftermath of World War II, Hosoki grew up in poverty and entered the nightlife world at a young age. By her twenties, she was running a series of successful clubs in Ginza, earning the nickname "The Queen of Ginza." Drawing on the instincts she developed there, she later reinvented herself as a fortune-teller whose influence swept the nation. She rose to prominence through her self-created Six Star Astrology and became a household name through bestselling books and frequent television appearances. Revered by some and feared by others, she left behind a legacy that continues to provoke fascination and debate.
title: Straight to Hell

overview: The funniest comics from NYC, Chicago and LA face off for a spot at Netflix Is a Joke Festival 2026 — with the winner crowned live by your real-time vote.
title: Funny AF with Kevin Hart

overview: Bait is about a struggling actor, whose last chance to hit it big comes in the form of an audition of a lifetime. The series follows him over the course of four wild days as his life spirals out of control and his family, ex-lover and the entire world weigh in on whether he is the right man for the job.
title: Bait

overview: The HBCU Legacy Bowl, is a postseason all-star game showcasing the best NFL draft-eligible football players from Historically Black Colleges and Universities. The event was announced by the Black College Football Hall of Fame on March 18, 2021.
title: HBCU Legacy Bowl

overview: Saban tells the story of Nick Saban's extraordinary career, highlighted by his 17 seasons at Alabama, where he led the team to six national titles and reestablished the Crimson Tide as the preeminent program in college football. The series will peel back the curtain on the long closely guarded world of Saban, with hundreds of hours of never-before-seen footage from the locker room and practice fields, as well as many other behind-the-scenes moments in his career at Alabama, and prior to that LSU, the Miami Dolphins, and Michigan State among other stops. There's also a wealth of present-day interviews with Saban and his wife, the legendary Ms. Terry Saban, whose own influence and impact played a massive role in Nick's success as a coach and leader. Saban is a portrait of the relentless drive that powered seven national titles (six at Alabama, and one at LSU), produced four Heisman trophy winners, generations of NFL stars, and set a standard of greatness in college football that may never be met again. It also explores "The Process," Saban's famed approach to coaching that transformed his teams and defined his leadership style.
title: Saban

overview: Voronezh, the noughties is a time when the glamour from magazines is just reaching the regions, stretch jeans are worn with sequins, "Hands Up!" sounds from every iron, salaries are no longer given out in biscuits, but life is still based on wit and family ties. 35-year—old Dasha is a divorced mother, works at a factory and secretly meets with her boss Roman. She lives in a three-bedroom apartment with her parents and 14-year-old daughter. But one day her sister Lena suddenly moves into the apartment with her husband Seryoga and two children. To defend the right to the only large room, Dasha decides to announce her relationship with Roman and force him to move in with her. Now there are nine people under one roof and every day turns into a survival comedy. At the same time, ten years later, Dasha's ex-husband Dima appears, confident that he must return his family and his former life. A real family blockbuster begins in the apartment, where the stakes are love, a roof over your head and a place on the couch.
title: Трёшка

overview: Two stolen lives and a 'suicide pact' that never was. In previously unbroadcast tapes, a killer coldly recounts how he got away with a double murder for 18 years.
title: Confessions of a Killer

overview: This is not a story about forgiveness; Revenge is a show about retribution. Meet Emily Thorne, the newest resident of The Hamptons. When she was a little girl (and known as Amanda Clarke) her father, David Clarke, was framed for a horrific crime and subsequently sent to prison. While serving his time, the conspirators plotted and murdered David in order to prevent the truth from coming out. Emily is now back with a new identity and ready to take vengeance on the people that murdered her father and stole her childhood.
title: Revenge

overview: When FBI Special Agent Audrey Parker is dispatched to the small town of Haven, Maine, on a routine case, she soon finds herself increasingly involved in the return of "The Troubles", a plague of supernatural afflictions that have occurred in the town at least twice before. With an openness to the possibility of the paranormal, she also finds a more personal link in Haven that may lead her to the mother she has never known. She and her partner, police detective Nathan Wuornos, find themselves frequently facing problems caused by both the effects of the Troubles, as well as the activities of town folk who take more drastic measures against those who are Troubled.
title: Haven

overview: Sean Vann is an American Logger with a plan -- a big plan. He's worked in the Russian forestry industry for the last seventeen years...but he's always been working for a boss. Now Sean is putting everything on the line for the opportunity of a lifetime in deepest Siberia. He has a 3-month contract to cut wood, set up his own operation and become master of his own destiny. There's just one snag: in order to fulfill his dream, Sean needs more men. He brings four American loggers to the frozen wilds of Siberia -- to work alongside his own Siberian crew. If Sean can fulfill his contract with the Russian colonel who runs the land, he is set to make hundreds of thousands of dollars. But if his dual nationality crew can't work together -- and survive temperatures of 40 below -- Sean's dream will be over before it even started.
title: Siberian Cut

overview: The social media star and trainspotter trains as an astronaut with one of the leading companies in commercial space flight, and under the guidance of Tim Peake.
title: Mission To Space with Francis Bourgeois

overview: After losing the world championship, Africa's boxing champion becomes a professional bodyguard seeking a second chance. Assigned to protect Donia, the daughter of a cunning businessman with hidden wealth and debts to a gambling lord. Salah and Donia embark on fiery chases, uncover secrets, and the hero finds love and redemption.
title: Batal Al Alam

overview: Milena, a young girl who experienced deep suffering and seeks help and consolation from God. She can't even ask for happiness. God agrees to help her by giving her the name Varvara so nobody could ever recognize or hurt her again.
title: Zvaces se Varvara

overview: In a small provincial town, a very topical issue is being addressed head-on, today, it is easy to see one's private life put on the streets and judged in a few hours, between real damage and the long wave of online comments.
title: A Testa Alta - Il Coraggio di una Donna

overview: An electrifying romantic comedy about a man whose artificial heart is running out of battery and a woman who has the power to recharge him. Baek Ho Rang, a third-generation chaebol heir leads one of the nation's top conglomerates' resorts, a gifted businessman he is skilled in strategizing and execution, and is a strong candidate to take over the group's leadership role — if not for his unspoken secret and only weakness: beneath his impeccable facade beats an artificial heart. Amid fierce power struggles with his heart battery running low, he encounters Na Bo Bae, a miraculous woman capable of recharging his battery. In an unplanned move, he offers her a contract she can't refuse. Na Bo Bae is a screenwriter with a looming deadline to finish a romance screenplay before her contract expires. Stuck by lightning as a child, she has electrical currents coursing through her body, making it impossible for her to even hold hands with someone she likes. When she meets Baek Ho Rang, the only person not shocked by touching her, she finally has the opportunity to jumpstart her love life.
title: Take Charge of My Heart

overview: Four friends – Kristina, Dasha, Natasha and Nastya - became friends in their native Yekaterinburg, but have been living completely different lives for a long time. Kristina moved to Moscow and became a real TV star, Dasha married a St. Petersburg football player, Nastya works as a doctor in Sochi, and Natasha remained in Yekaterinburg. But the heroines still found a way to always stay together: their chat. For them, this is an opportunity to openly share their experiences, support each other and go through life side by side, even being thousands of kilometers away.
title: Чат

overview: Sassy and selfish Margot has built herself the most comfortable lifestyle possible – she works as a stripper, hangs out with her friends, and dates a total loser just like her. But all the fun goes to hell when Margot suddenly becomes the guardian of two spoiled nephews – fifteen-year-old Polina and fourteen-year-old Lyosha. The irresponsible stripper will have to grow up in a hurry, and the children, accustomed to wealth, will have to adapt to ordinary life.
title: Тётка

overview: Things You Shouldn't Say Past Midnight explores a variety of modern-day relationships through the conceit that nothing good happens after midnight. The series is set in L.A. and takes viewers on a 12-hour collision course that begins at dusk and explodes at dawn.
title: Things You Shouldn't Say Past Midnight

overview: Series shows the shocking murders that have happened in recent years in Poland. Each episode is dedicated to a different, fact-based crime that seemed like an accidental death.
title: Polskie Prywatne Zbrodnie

overview: Av måneskinn gror det ingenting is an award-winning Norwegian drama series in three parts airing in October 1987. Based on the iconic 1947 Torborg Nedraas novel by the same name, the series depicts a young woman, Clara, and her battle towards a gruesome abortion in the late 1940s.
title: Av måneskinn gror det ingenting

overview: Medmenneske is a Norwegian drama series.
title: Medmenneske

overview: Anna, a mute young woman and the sole survivor, is urgently extracted to a windswept Atlantic island. There lives Victor Coste, a police officer who has exiled himself to the other side of the world. Cut off from everything, he accepts one last mission: to get Anna to talk, identify the killer, and prevent him from striking again. But when the world's densest fog rolls in, a race against time begins, as the island itself turns into a trap.
title: Les brumes

overview: The Astrology House follows the cosmically intertwined lives of Rini and Margot. When Rini invites Margot and her family-and-friend group to vacation at her astrology retreat, long-held resentments, secrets and lies boil over, culminating in death.
title: The Astrology House

overview: Nuannuan—the girl she once left behind in her youth—reenters her life as an assistant. Under the pressure of fame and public scrutiny, the two escape the city to join a rural reality show. Meanwhile, veteran manager Si Han and superstar Jiang Wan are locked in a fierce game of love and power, entangled in workplace rivalry and unresolved past feelings. Between tenderness and cruelty, sincerity and calculation, two GL love stories unfold against the unforgiving reality of the entertainment industry.
title: Candy

overview: Foul Play with Anthony Davis pairs elite athletes with elaborate pranks, giving them one chance to pull off their mischievous plans or foul out trying.
title: Foul Play with Anthony Davis

overview: Rimuru's Glamorous Life as a Teacher follows Rimuru as he's summoned to the Freedom Academy in the Kingdom of Ingrassia and unexpectedly assigned to teach a small class of children whose lives are in danger. Each child carries an unstable spirit that's slowly consuming them from the inside, and unless someone intervenes, they won't survive into adulthood. Rimuru takes responsibility for them, stepping into the role of a mentor while searching for a way to stabilize their powers before time runs out. Across the trilogy, he trains them, protects them, and gradually earns their trust, all while uncovering the truth behind their condition. The story blends lighthearted school-life comedy with a surprisingly emotional rescue mission, showing a side of Rimuru that's more nurturing and personal than in the main series. This OAD series were bundled with manga volumes 14-16.
title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime Gaiden: Rimuru's Glamorous Life as a Teacher

overview: Reality meets romance, with a little twist, in the surprising dating show I Wanna Marry Harry. Summer love is in the air, as an average English "bloke" is given the royal treatment and an upper crust makeover before meeting 12 single American women searching for Prince Charming. Will he be able to convince them he's regal? And if he does, will they fall for the crown, or fall in love with the real him? Join "Harry" as he courts each of the ladies, taking them on romantic dates worthy of a princess and trying to make some version of their fairytales come true.
title: I Wanna Marry Harry

overview: It is estimated that there are thousands of people in the UK with the brains of a genius, from all walks of life and backgrounds – who don't even know it. Secret Genius will see Alan Carr and Susie Dent test Britain's brainpower like never before to uncover the country's most gifted and unsung minds.
title: Secret Genius

overview: Vote for Me aims to find an "ordinary" member of the public to stand as an independent candidate for the 2005 UK election.
title: Vote for Me

overview: Series following the investigators who must hunt for the truth and bring the guilty to justice.
title: 999: What Happened Next

overview: In another time and place, Son Hak and the dragons banter as they hold a drinking contest. As they start to doze off one-by-one, Zeno dreams of his past, where his abilities and experiences, both as a person and as the Yellow Dragon, are revealed.
title: Yona of the Dawn: Kou Ryuu Zeno Kako-hen

overview: After the capture, Hajime was worried about the farewell to Myuu that would occur when the trip resumed. Hajime and his friends were talking about "The Seven Great Legends of Erisen" as a memory before they left for the trip, but all of them were missed. However, in the final seventh adventure, he encounters a mysterious giant creature and is blown into the world of a devastated city! Hajime, who started to search for the stray Myuu, fulfills a miraculous encounter there. This two-part sub-story was released on blu-ray set volume 1 and 2 respectively.
title: Arifureta: The Miraculous Meeting and the Phantasmagorical Adventure

overview: The legendary Chosen's Sword returns, shaking the Jianghu. Cold, aloof Wei Gui sets out to uncover his past, meeting passionate Lei Lingze at a mountain temple. Joined by the mysterious Ye Zhixin and storyteller Hua Xiaohua, they hunt for the sword. But when Ye Zhixin is revealed as the hidden leader of a dark sect, their bond shatters. Facing betrayal, loss, and chaos, Wei Gui and Lei Lingze unite their blades to cut through the conspiracy and defend justice.
title: The Blood of Youth: Quest of Heroic Hearts

overview: After surviving a severe attack, Prof. Dr. İnan Kural, the distinguished chief physician of Umutpark Medical Foundation Hospital, returns to life with no memory of the past 12 years. He finds himself in a world that feels completely unfamiliar. The years he lived are far from even being memories for him, and he struggles to recognize even himself. Surrounded by unfamiliar relationships, incomprehensible bonds, and unanswered questions, he is forced to rebuild his life from scratch.
title: Doktor: Başka Hayatta

overview: The Thicke family is going through major changes this fall, both in their personal lives and at home in a wall-destroying, star-studded new season of Unusually Thicke. America's favourite TV dad Alan Thicke is busy coordinating his workload of TV and film appearances while his wife Tanya is ready to inject some youthful energy into their home with her list of contemporary renovations. Meanwhile, Carter is getting ready for the leap into manhood, also known as college. Watch how the members of this intrepid celebrity family navigate change on the new season of Unusually Thicke.
title: Unusually Thicke

overview: Trainee Detective Eva Bennett returns to Manchester and joins a new homicide investigation run by her fearsome estranged mother - the legendary Detective Chief Inspector Lois Mercer. As they navigate their complicated relationship and long-buried truths resurface, Eva starts to uncover Lois' crimes, forcing an impossible choice between justice and blood.
title: Dirty

overview: A bold and heartfelt interview series where autistic and neurodivergent hosts take the lead, asking the questions everyone else avoids. With honesty, curiosity, and zero filters, no topic is off-limits, resulting in raw, funny, and deeply human conversations that challenge assumptions and redefine how stories are told.
title: The Assembly Ireland

overview: Explores the mysterious death of Bianca Rudolph on an African hunting trip. Accused is wealthy Pittsburgh-area dentist Larry Rudolph.
title: Trophy Wife: Murder on Safari
Chong Hui 87 Zhi Zhang Shang Ming Zhu

overview: Beloved Empress Navier of the Eastern Empire has built and led a prosperous land alongside her husband, Emperor Sovieshu. One day her world is shattered when the emperor brings Rashta, a runaway slave, back to the palace with the intention of making her his mistress. But even as the threat of a broken future looms over her, Navier refuses to let her emotions sway her, and when Prince Heinrey, a rival leader of the Western Kingdom, shows interest in her, Navier will make a life-changing decision to rewrite her destiny.
title: The Remarried Empress

overview: Dr Jordan B Peterson draws upon his extensive research and relatable real-life experiences to illustrate how to develop attainable goals for intimate relationships, meaningful friendships, and your career. Transform the chaotic potential of the future into actuality — with a vision.
title: Vision & Destiny

overview: Real History with Matt Walsh confronts the lies used to rewrite America's past. It challenges decades of propaganda, questions untouchable stories, and reexamines the history generations were taught to reject.
title: Real History with Matt Walsh

overview: They can accelerate faster than a Ferrari, strike with 10 times the g-force of a space shuttle, and outmaneuver a fighter jet. These are the fastest animals on Earth, and they use their speed to lethal effect in some of the planet's most combative environments. Take a journey across deserts, dense jungles, and murky lagoons, and see how predators and prey run, swim, and fly for their lives. We capture every movement in high definition, at 1,000 frames-per-second, so you won't miss one graphic detail of this fast-paced and often violent world.
title: Speed Kills

overview: At La Galana, the family estate of the Marquises of Monteclaro, the most valuable stallion is found poisoned along with several foals from the stable. This event shakes the apparent tranquillity of the family and triggers an investigation that threatens to uncover a complex web of buried secrets, crossed loyalties, economic tensions and unresolved wounds.
title: Pura Sangre

overview: In this series, the Time Scanners use cutting-edge 3D laser-scanning technology to put history's building wonders to the test, exploring the secrets of how the world's most iconic engineering creations were constructed. Leading the quest is structural engineer Steve Burrows. He is joined by laser-scanning experts from the Center For Advanced Spatial Technologies at the University of Arkansas. With unprecedented access, they explore, scan and digitally analyse some of mankind's most awe-inspiring architectural achievements, uncovering just how good the engineers of the ancient world really are. Locations include the Colosseum, Petra, Machu Picchu, St. Paul's Cathedral, the Pyramids and Jerusalem.
title: Time Scanners

overview: Fantasy challenges in a futuristic building with a humanoid lift.
title: Incredible Games

overview: After being assaulted and shamed by society, a 19th-century woman retaliates by opening a luxurious brothel, defying norms and rising as a powerful courtesan.
title: Dona Beja

overview: Explore A Knight of the Seven Kingdom in this rivering Look at how HBO's newest show in th universe was brought to life.
title: A Knight in the Making

overview: For eight weeks, Eric Goens explores every corner of the international drug trade.
title: Dealen Met Coke

overview: Wenika is a young woman who has managed to rise above her middle-class beginnings. She has established her cosmetic brand with the help of her best friends, Maynee and Banthao. However, when she yearns to grow and expand her business, Thirakit, a young investor from Malaysia comes into her life and is ready to invest. This is everything Wenika has been looking for. The problem — Thirakit is the young playboy who slept with and dumped her best friend, Maynee. He's also mysterious and showing likeness for Wenika and what's worse he seems to be plotting to take over Wenika's company with his 'aunt.'
title: Love Hurts

overview: The ordinary daily life of Yotsuba Fu, a college student with zero romantic experience, is suddenly turned upside down one day. The senior admired by everyone on campus, Kogami Sara, abruptly tells him that he is someone who came from a parallel world, and that "we are lovers", declaring it unilaterally. Confused by this sudden confession from Sara, with whom he has never even exchanged words before, Fu nevertheless finds himself gradually drawn to him. However, he soon begins to suffer from the inner conflict that he himself is not the Fu whom Sara loved in that parallel world. At the same time, Sara is also carrying a major secret of his own… Guided together by the threads of fate, what path of love will the two ultimately choose?
title: The Boy Next World: Heikousekai no Koibito

overview: An Israeli air force officer learns that his parents and sister are members of a dormant Russian spy cell, and Russia wants him to betray his country.
title: The Gordin Cell

overview: Two former classmates, one an heiress with a past crush and the other a rising star model, reunite when they're cast in a Girls' Love series. Pingrak—formerly a nerd, now a beautiful, ultra-rich heiress to a massive department store empire—once had a secret crush on P'Charm, her former ice-cold senior and a school star. Today, she's a rising model. Back then, she brought her horrible sadness. From a love that was once one-sided between them, the two are suddenly thrown together as the leads in a Girls' Love series.
title: Frozen Valentine

overview: Businessman Roman Sokolov and his partner fall into the hands of law enforcement agencies on suspicion of fraud on a particularly large scale. However, Roman made a deal with the investigation in advance: as a result, his accomplice is sent to jail, and he and his daughter Alice are transported to Blagoveshchensk under the witness protection program. Now they are the "Khomyakov family", and their safety is provided by Major Sveta and Captain Grisha. Roman will have to play the role of an exemplary family man, live in a "fake" police family and establish relations with his daughter Alice, who is not at all happy about the move.
title: Госзащита

overview: From dazzling outfits to spectacular routines, this sparkling reality series showcases the passionate, dramatic world of competitive ice dance.
title: Glitter & Gold: Ice Dancing

overview: An Austrian influencer moves to Los Angeles chasing fame and fortune, but soon finds himself caught in one mishap after another -- proving that in LA, it's easier to get lost than to get famous.
title: Very Lost in LA

overview: UFO: POV is a hard-hitting UFO series led by renowned expert Chris Rutkowski. Each episode investigates a real unexplained encounter, combining eyewitness testimony, on-the-ground investigation and decades of research to uncover what really happened.
title: UFO: POV

overview: As war rages in Eastern Europe, the British Army is readying its infantry platoons for action. These platoons – 30 strong units of soldiers who eat, sleep and fight alongside each other – are the backbone of the British Army. This series follows one newly assembled platoon in The Rifles, the British Army's largest infantry regiment, preparing for possible frontline deployment. Filmed over six brutal months, they must develop soldiering skills to compete with a battle-hardened enemy and grow into a band of brothers so tight they will lay down their lives for each other.
title: Platoon 24/7: Preparing for War

overview: On Cesar 911, Cesar Millan is back in his element - rehabilitating dogs and training people, but this time he's bringing his skills to a community near you. Each week Cesar will travel to a community that is in desperate need of his help. He is summoned by neighbors, co-workers, relatives and friends who "blow the whistle" on a four-legged menace that has turned their lives upside down. Whether it's a spoiled Chihuahua going wild in a family business or an aggressive mutt spreading fear throughout a neighborhood, Cesar will use his unparalleled expertise to bring balance to the dogs and the community. Each episode will consist of two stories within one community and conclude with all parties coming together at a central meeting place, now equipped with the knowledge and tools only Cesar Millan can provide.
title: Cesar 911

overview: 10 short stories about social media and bullying.
title: #HATETAG

overview: El Mochaorejas follows a journalist who, through archives and testimonies, reconstructs the rise of a legendary kidnapper and the web of fear and secrets that still marks Mexico.
title: El Mochaorejas

overview: This chilling true crime series delves into the UK's most extraordinary cases, including a passionate affair that led to a double murder and a body buried in a teacher's garden.
title: Killer In The House

overview: 'Nordic Blue' crime drama HILDUR, based on the best-selling novels by Satu Rämö. A surfing female detective fights against time to confront a serial killer in the fjords of Iceland while unraveling the mystery of her long-lost sisters.
title: Hildur

overview: After falling into a body of water, Pennueng is transported into the body of a literary heroine she once studied in a textbook, famed for her misfortune. This heroine was fought over by two men and sentenced to death, charged as a "woman of two hearts." Her only chance to escape her fate is to flee far from these two men. Whether it's the one we love or the one who loves us, this "Wanthong" wants neither of them!!
title: Loveless Heroine

overview: During a family vacation in the Dominican Republic, Elena accidentally hits a man with her car. Desperate and frightened, she calls her sisters, Paula and Cris, asking for help. Upon arrival, they must decide how to handle the accident, as they cannot bear the thought of their younger sister going to jail, leaving her only child without a mother. How far will they be willing to go to help protect their family?
title: Esa noche

overview: Teenagers have been reformed — we take care of their parents! Meet the premiere on the TV channel "Yu" — "Child from hell. The ancestors." The characters who were once young majors turned to our reality show with a request to send their moms and dads for re-education. And we couldn't refuse them...
title: Чадо из ада - Предки

overview: Models, judges and "ANTM" insiders — including Tyra Banks — look back at the reality show's complicated legacy in this eye-opening documentary series.
title: Reality Check: Inside America's Next Top Model

overview: Lindsay is an American docuseries that documents actress Lindsay Lohan's rehabilitation recovery and work following a public period of struggles in her personal life and career. The series premiered on March 9, 2014 on the Oprah Winfrey Network, and concluded on April 20, 2014. Premiere ratings were described as "modest" and then dropped, while critical reception was mixed.
title: Lindsay

overview: Award winning actress Zhan Lu takes in her former patron, Yi Heng, at the lowest point of his life, turning their relationship completely upside down. What begins as a transaction slowly grows into genuine love as the two stand together against public scrutiny and family opposition in the world of fame and power. As the truth comes to light, Yi Heng's prestigious background is revealed, yet he willingly chooses to be "kept" for the sake of love. Meanwhile, Zhan Lu discovers her true self through both her career and romance, and the two ultimately find their happy ending together.
title: Wild Heartbeat

overview: On the eve of her engagement, Ding Dang unexpectedly reunites with her first love, Chen Aming, only to find he has changed his name to Yu Kun and assumed a new identity. To heal Chen Aming's personality disorder caused by a failed experiment, Ding Dang and her friends secretly devise a "Sugarcoat" plan. It aims to guide him in confronting past traumas and breaking free from fractured emotions and memories.
title: Sugar and Lies

overview: Ye Xiao'ai, an aspiring designer, and Zhuang Lili, a model fleeing domestic abuse, cross paths by chance and form a friendship. Xiao'ai helps Lili stand up to her husband Li Jin, while Lili helps Xiao'ai resolve the emotional entanglements with her "brother-in-law" Lin Sen. In their fierce but loving sisterhood, both chase their dreams and ultimately embrace a brand new life.
title: Dark and Dawn

overview: After losing her memory, Qiao Xiaomi is targeted by her brother, Zhiwei, at their father's funeral. Just then, her fiancé Qin Yu, who vanished three years ago, suddenly returns and comes to her rescue. With Qin Yu's help, Xiaomi's memories begin to point to a deadly fire. But Qin Yu's return was actually orchestrated by Zhiwei. As the truth comes to light, their love, built on a lie, faces its greatest test.
title: Visage and Soul

overview: The rich but naive Fan Sha'er is buried alive by his own father for raiding a grain depot. After escaping, he meets Xiugu and her father, who run a hotpot restaurant. Persecuted by Master Huo and guided by the mystic Xuanjizi, he accidentally joins a bandit gang. Rising to become its leader, he forms a sworn brotherhood to uphold justice. After killing Japanese invaders, his group is integrated into the formal army. Through battlefield achievements and strict discipline, including banning gambling, he eventually grows into a division commander leading troops against the Japanese.
title: The Naive Leader

overview: In the late summer of the 1980s, an unexpected event intertwines the fates of the feuding Zheng and Wang families. After losing her factory job, Wang Yingrong, the second daughter of the Wang family, struggles in pig farming before finding success in vinegar brewing, all with the help of Zheng Minjiang, the eldest son of the Zheng family. As they work together, affection quietly grows between them. In the end, the longstanding rift between the two families heals, turning a generational feud into a bond of marriage.
title: A Summer Meant for Us

overview: Neighbors examines stories of absurd, outrageous, and dramatic real-life residential conflicts from a wide range of larger-than-life characters across the United States, opening a verité portal into the lives of contemporary Americans. Each episode introduces a new set of neighbors in the heat of their grievances, uncovering spirited disputes about property lines, animal ownership, and even a yellow Speedo. Directors and emerging talents Harrison Fishman and Dylan Redford filmed for over two years, traveling across the country and fully immersing themselves in these neighbors' lives to capture an unfiltered and intimate portrait of everyday people and document the fundamentally American pursuits of life, liberty, and property.
title: Neighbors

overview: As the Deputy Minister of the Court of Judicial Review, Zhang Yi harbors a bloody vendetta, biding his time in silence. Outwardly, he joins forces with Shen Youzhi of the Imperial Guards to track down criminals, their relationship evolving from confrontation to cooperation. In secret, however, he is the mastermind pulling the strings of revenge. When all conspiracies converge towards an end, a meticulously crafted trap for justice suddenly springs shut. The fates of all involved collide violently in this moment, culminating in a final choice amidst a labyrinth of espionage and shadows.
title: The 300 Loyal Ghosts

overview: Su Yunian infiltrates the glittering, decadent world of "The Heart of Opulence" to uncover the truth behind her sister's death, only to be swept into a deadly power struggle between Nie Feng and Tu Jiasheng. She soon learns her sister was silenced for possessing crucial evidence. As danger mounts, betrayed by her closest friend, framed by the top courtesan, and relentlessly pursued by Nie Feng, Su Yunian walks a razor's edge between enmity and alliance with Tu Jiasheng. In this realm of illusions, every glimmer hides a blood-stained lie.
title: The Glory Fades
